source_findings.kernel_committed_state: src/kernel/mod_kernel_transactions.f90 stores one opaque transaction_state_t physical/canonical carrier plus lineage/revision/time; checkpoint clones it and candidate commit move_alloc publishes it atomically.
source_findings.inner_transaction_semantics: The canonical interval engine advances cloned transaction states through private accepted substeps before external candidate materialization.
source_findings.current_B110_state: src/runtime/mod_fmr_serialized_reference_backend.f90 defines fmr_b110_physical_state_t as the canonical transaction-state subtype and its clone implementation controls exact retry/checkpoint isolation.
source_findings.template_hook: src/runtime/mod_fmr_runtime_core.f90 already separates state_layout_id from optional_state_layout_id, so optional continuation storage can be selected by template rather than added to every logical column.

candidate_decisions.reason: Worker/model objects are reusable execution objects; history would not be authoritative per column lineage and would leak under A-B-A/retry reuse.
F-KT09 can accept multiple private substeps inside one external interval; history must advance between those accepted substeps, not only after external publication.
Would require a second sidecar transaction across every inner accepted substep or invasive changes to the canonical transaction API.
Even an unallocated descriptor would impose optional-feature state shape on inactive columns and would not use the existing optional_state_layout_id separation.

An indicator-enabled template can use a subtype of fmr_b110_physical_state_t containing a separately typed temporal numerical-continuation payload. The existing transaction clone/accept/rollback mechanics then carry physical and continuation categories atomically while inactive templates retain the unchanged base state type.

selected_design.availability_semantics: payload allocation plus finite correct-shape vector; no synthetic zero history
selected_design.template_selection: nonzero dedicated optional_state_layout_id identifies indicator-enabled state topology
selected_design.inactive_template_storage: unchanged base state type; no derivative vector and no continuation payload object
selected_design.clone_rule: dynamic type and optional continuation payload must be preserved exactly by clone
selected_design.mass_rule: storage() continues to use only water_content, ponding and active physical process storage; temporal continuation is ignored by mass accounting
selected_design.inner_substep_rule: model advance mutates continuation only on the trial clone after a converged solve; transaction rejection discards that clone, accepted route publishes it as the next private canonical state
selected_design.external_commit_rule: existing kernel candidate commit move_alloc publishes the accepted composite state once; no second commit authority
selected_design.solver_boundary: runtime passes only the explicit previous derivative value to the F-SI25 public solver service; no HeadCalc arrays enter continuation state

F_SI25_scope_hold.physical_or_solver_topology_change: must use a different template/optional state layout and may not silently carry qualified-history availability across the change
